record.question: A government servant has already submitted a transfer request through proper official channel. Pending decision, he asks a respected community leader to personally speak to the superior authority so that his posting may be considered favourably. Which of the following is the most accurate position?
options: The conduct is prohibited under Rule 20
The conduct is not prohibited because the Government servant had first submitted a representation through proper channel.
The conduct is prohibited only if the community leader is a politician or elected representative.
The conduct is not prohibited unless the superior authority actually grants the favourable posting.
